name: 2020-2021 Demographic Snapshot Borough
description: This dataset provides demographic snapshots of student enrollment in New York City public schools by borough for the 2020-2021 school year. Each row represents a borough and includes total enrollment along with counts by grade level, from 3K and pre-K through grade 12. It also breaks down enrollment by gender, race and ethnicity (Asian, Black, Hispanic, multiracial, Native American, and White), and counts students with disabilities, English language learners, and students in poverty. Several columns appear in paired form, likely representing counts alongside percentages or prior-year comparisons. An economic need index is included as a summary measure. The data could support analyses of enrollment patterns, demographic composition, and equity across boroughs, such as comparing the share of English language learners or students in poverty between areas, or examining how grade-level enrollment varies geographically.
